name: BlockFrame
avoid_for: Contexts that require quiet institutional restraint or traditional weight (regulated disclosures, formal legal briefs)
weak_cases: Stacking every card adds noise; long small text loses hierarchy inside nested frames.
visual_signature: Thick coupled borders and hard shadows, tilted objects and border-only secondary cards.

provenance.adaptation: Recipe retained and curated for Deck Studio; selector describes source-supported structures, not rendered acceptance.

language_posture: The voice relies more on border and object geometry than letterforms; still verify chosen fonts and line breaks.

assets.images: No image required; type, shapes and surface treatments can carry the system.
